rows.text: Completed stellar mission objective!
Completed all stellar mission objectives!
[Only available for use during cosmic exploration.]

Goodness me, it seems you've completed all the <var 28 ((ClassJob)) E80201 /var> research we had prepared for!
Ahem... For the moment, please stand by!
Ahem! <var 2B ((<var 28 ((ClassJob)) E80201 /var>)) /var> research has proceeded sufficiently, so you may report to headquarters for debriefing.
Ahem. Your current progress in cosmic <var 28 ((ClassJob)) E80201 /var> research is as follows.
If this goes like this...then that must go like...<var 1A 02 /var>that<var 1A 01 /var>...
Our research modules are based on those of the Studium, you know.
The further your cosmic research progresses, the better tools you might create! Exciting, no?
High-level research requires data of profound intricacy. Either you're capable of the task or, well. Ahem.
By expanding your research into other specialities, you can increase your overall efficiency!
<buzz> ...at's odd...<buzz>...onnection's distor... <buzz>
Phaenna is rife with resources most brilliant. One need look no further than the incredible progress we've made with our research as proof!
Phaenna is home to flora as fascinating as they come, no? They sparkle and shine with such beauty under the microscope...
We tried to map the rifts in Capsule Chasm, but our instruments couldn't fathom their depths. Best watch your step when exploring the area!
When Fusingway Vent's bubbling expanse of molten glass cools, it turns from fiery red to a resplendent rainbow of color! A splendid visual treat, to be sure.
Reserved for “<var 28 ((Fate)) E80201 /var>”
Ahem!? It appears my research material is particularly buoyant in our current gravity!
I spilled my beverage near some floating rocks, and the droplets simply lingered in midair alongside their stony counterparts... How fascinating!
Not to brag, but our research actively contributes to gravity generation upon this star. ...All right, maybe I <var 1A 02 /var>do<var 1A 01 /var> mean to brag.
The vestiges of this star's previous civilization remain, in large part, a mystery. We rely upon the hard work of all contributors to further our research!
'Twould seem that unique and advanced magicks once powered the ruins of this star. What would Hydaelyn think of such miraculous feats, I wonder?
At last, we have completed all possible research! Your dedication is inspirational, <var 2C ((<var 29 EB02 /var>)) (( )) 02 /var>. A thousand thousand thanks!
Ahem. Your current progress in cosmic <var 28 ((ClassJob)) E80201 /var> research is...complete!? Sweet Mother Hydaelyn! Marvelous work!
This star and Etheirys share some startling similarities, from the atmospheric composition to the abundance of flora. I approve, ahem.
Do you not find the architecture here remarkable!? Tens of thousands of years old, and yet the wood stands strong! Genius design, I tell you...
The Cosmic Harvester is a triumph of our unique mech technology. Or so Alerot has informed me. <var 1A 02 /var>Extensively<var 1A 01 /var>.
This star's towerlings are organic bodies that accumulate vast amounts of information. As for <var 1A 02 /var>how<var 1A 01 /var> they do this...your guess is as good as mine!
Now that we've dusted the cobwebs off Grandma Laurel, I daresay we're in for some tales that only our elders can provide...
